scenario: Edit a page without a deploy
setup_and_steps: Owner changes homepage heading and saves draft; compare database revision and public browser.
expected_observable_result: New immutable draft exists; public page unchanged; no code/SQL/deploy step.

setup_and_steps: Create two pages with the same normalized site path, including trailing slash/case handling.
expected_observable_result: One unique normalized path per site; clear conflict; reserved paths rejected.

setup_and_steps: Duplicate a published page containing linked products and media.
expected_observable_result: New page/section IDs and draft path; references retained with authorization; no automatic publication.

setup_and_steps: Archive a page linked in navigation and an active release.
expected_observable_result: Dependency/redirect review required; selected release removes page; history retained.

setup_and_steps: Restore an archived page from history.
expected_observable_result: New draft with validated references; previous published release stays unchanged.

setup_and_steps: Approve release, choose site timezone and future date/time, inspect stored UTC and public state.
expected_observable_result: Stored UTC matches explicit local time; only approved immutable release is scheduled.

setup_and_steps: Schedule a nonexistent spring time and ambiguous autumn time in a DST timezone.
expected_observable_result: Reject nonexistent time and require explicit offset choice for ambiguity; display resolved UTC.

setup_and_steps: Schedule a release, cancel it, deliver its original job again.
expected_observable_result: Cancelled job never activates; actor/reason and cancellation are auditable.

setup_and_steps: Queue release against generation N; activate a different release; run queued job.
expected_observable_result: Expected-generation mismatch blocks job visibly; later content is not overwritten.

setup_and_steps: Stop executor through promotion expiry; resume and deliver jobs.
expected_observable_result: Expired release does not publish; late nonexpired handling follows explicit policy with visible status.

setup_and_steps: Move a selected section up/down using keyboard alone.
expected_observable_result: Stable section ID, focus retained, announced position; same draft/preview order.

setup_and_steps: Drag a section from first to last and save draft.
expected_observable_result: Saved structured order matches canvas; keyboard alternative remains; no duplicate IDs.

setup_and_steps: Hide a section, preview, publish selected revision and restore visibility.
expected_observable_result: Hidden section absent from public DOM/metadata; editor shows hidden state; order preserved.

setup_and_steps: Insert each enabled component; choose a permitted layout; inspect preview.
expected_observable_result: Required fields shown; unsupported/disabled components unavailable with reason.

setup_and_steps: Submit unknown block, unsupported schemaVersion, duplicate section IDs and unknown properties.
expected_observable_result: Validation fails before write/publication; existing content unchanged.

setup_and_steps: Publish sections missing required headings, alt text, permitted references or consent evidence.
expected_observable_result: Specific actionable errors identify section/field; draft may retain incomplete state but cannot publish.

setup_and_steps: Submit script tags, event handlers, deep AST nesting and unsafe marks/links.
expected_observable_result: No executable/raw HTML is accepted or rendered; bounded permitted AST works.

setup_and_steps: Open same draft at 1440, 768 and 390 widths.
expected_observable_result: Same exact draft revision rendered; useful device controls; no unintended surrounding editor overflow.

setup_and_steps: Request draft preview as anonymous, customer, wrong tenant and wrong site; inspect metadata too.
expected_observable_result: All unauthorized reads denied; owner/scoped editor sees only granted exact revision.

setup_and_steps: Prime authenticated preview then fetch public page from separate context/process.
expected_observable_result: Preview private/no-store/noindex; no draft bytes or tokens appear in public/shared cache.

setup_and_steps: Read page/header/footer/theme repeatedly while activating a release.
expected_observable_result: Every response uses one coherent release manifest; no mixed global/page revisions.

setup_and_steps: Create unrelated drafts on three pages; approve and publish one page.
expected_observable_result: Only chosen approved changes join active manifest; other drafts remain private.

setup_and_steps: Approve a revision; edit its body/image before publication.
expected_observable_result: Approval remains bound to old hash; new revision needs review and cannot reuse approval silently.

setup_and_steps: Two editors save from the same row revision.
expected_observable_result: Second stale save receives conflict/diff; neither silently overwrites first; history remains.

setup_and_steps: Publish page and an unrelated page; roll first page back to an eligible old revision.
expected_observable_result: New audited release restores selected page only and retains other current changes.

setup_and_steps: Choose prior coherent site release, inspect diff and activate rollback as owner.
expected_observable_result: New audited release pins reviewed page/nav/theme set; transactions are untouched.

setup_and_steps: Revoke image rights/pause a product; attempt rollback referencing it.
expected_observable_result: Rollback validation blocks/removes unsafe dependency; cannot republish revoked material.

setup_and_steps: Attempt scoped SQL/API updates/deletes on recorded published revisions and manifests.
expected_observable_result: Runtime rejects mutations; new revisions/releases append; audit includes actor/reason/hash.

setup_and_steps: Use two tenants/workspaces/sites; guess IDs across list/read/write/preview/reference APIs.
expected_observable_result: No cross-scope rows/metadata; composite scoped references cannot point across boundaries.

setup_and_steps: Save permitted palette versus arbitrary unsafe or inconsistent token overrides.
expected_observable_result: Only allowed semantic tokens/variants accepted; impact preview and history available.

setup_and_steps: Render all permitted button/text/focus combinations with accent #FF3F1A.
expected_observable_result: Normal text meets 4.5:1; white normal text on accent is rejected; focus is perceivable.

setup_and_steps: Compare logo reference/hash/lockup before theme migration and after a theme publication.
expected_observable_result: Existing logo preserved; replacement requires explicit approved operation; no invented mark.

setup_and_steps: Select an approved font then submit arbitrary remote font URL/unapproved font.
expected_observable_result: Only licensed approved font IDs; fallback/loading verified; no arbitrary remote URL injection.

setup_and_steps: Edit global navigation/footer, preview affected pages and publish selected globals.
expected_observable_result: All intended pages use same approved globals; unrelated pages remain internally coherent.

setup_and_steps: Create/reorder main/footer/mobile items, exceed depth and create cycles.
expected_observable_result: Shared ordered semantic tree; cycles/depth rejected; keyboard editor supported.

setup_and_steps: Select approved menu image and link; try private artwork or invalid asset scope.
expected_observable_result: Approved derivative appears with alt text; private/unapproved media denied server-side.

setup_and_steps: Try /api, /account, /cart, /products and unsafe external redirect targets.
expected_observable_result: Business routes cannot be shadowed; valid path changes use reviewed internal redirect records.

setup_and_steps: Open menus at 390 px and keyboard-only desktop, Escape, Tab and return focus.
expected_observable_result: Named controls, correct expanded state, usable focus order and no accidental trapped focus.

setup_and_steps: Build collection from published product IDs, publish page and compare projection.
expected_observable_result: Only existing scoped canonical IDs; no copied product database or stale editable prices.

setup_and_steps: Toggle merchandising visibility/featured state and inspect affected collection and global catalog semantics.
expected_observable_result: Chosen merchandising scope is explicit; hiding a feature does not silently pause product globally.

setup_and_steps: Rank collection items and choose product-bound compatible variant/image.
expected_observable_result: Order stable across pages; exact valid variant/derivative shown; wrong-product asset rejected.

setup_and_steps: Assign category/brand/industry/occasion/solution, combine filters and visit solution page.
expected_observable_result: Canonical facets/search and solution collections agree; no hardcoded duplicate product facts.

setup_and_steps: Edit homepage featured categories/collections then publish.
expected_observable_result: Cards resolve approved names/images/routes in order; empty/ineligible targets fail safely.

setup_and_steps: Publish curated page, pause referenced product, fetch page again from two app contexts.
expected_observable_result: Product cannot be offered through old page snapshot; availability gates and cache behavior verified.

setup_and_steps: Seed supplier cost/credentials, private source notes, audiences and artwork IDs; inspect public JSON/HTML/metadata.
expected_observable_result: None appear in response, serialized data, URLs, alt text or logs intended for public access.

setup_and_steps: Edit approved title/description, publish, change slug and inspect canonical/sitemap/redirect.
expected_observable_result: Published eligible pages only; draft/private sites noindex; scoped safe redirect lifecycle.

setup_and_steps: Upload reusable website image with incomplete rights then approve a scoped derivative.
expected_observable_result: Private quarantine until checks; picker explains rights state; approval is deliberate/audited.

setup_and_steps: Upload disguised file, excessive dimensions and EXIF-bearing image.
expected_observable_result: Unsafe upload rejected/quarantined; optimized derivative strips metadata and records dimensions/hash.

setup_and_steps: Paste another customer original ID into hero, query media picker and request direct URL.
expected_observable_result: No bytes or sensitive metadata leak; no publication via guessed IDs; ownership enforced.

setup_and_steps: Try publishing raw supplier template/source and an unapproved download.
expected_observable_result: Private originals remain unavailable; only explicitly approved permitted derivatives can publish.

setup_and_steps: Reuse asset on page/nav/campaign; attempt deletion and inspect dependents.
expected_observable_result: Complete reference list; active use blocks destructive delete; replacement/release workflow preserved.

setup_and_steps: Publish image, revoke/expire rights, fetch through supported app/CDN paths and try rollback.
expected_observable_result: New reads honor agreed revocation policy; dependency blocks publication/rollback; caches invalidated.

setup_and_steps: Edit image alt text/focal point at three widths; mark only true decoration decorative.
expected_observable_result: Meaningful images have useful text; crop preserves content; no accidental empty product names.

setup_and_steps: Add approved video/poster/captions; try missing captions, unsafe embeds and autoplay audio.
expected_observable_result: Only supported approved origins/files; captions/transcript/keyboard work; invalid feature disabled.

setup_and_steps: Offer accessible approved PDF then try unscanned file/private source/expired resource.
expected_observable_result: Only rights-approved checked derivative downloadable; meaningful labels; failures remain unavailable.

setup_and_steps: Create seasonal/industry/event/fundraising landing from reusable template and link campaign.
expected_observable_result: Selected approved revision resolves published collection; no implicit discount or commerce change.

setup_and_steps: Select same rights-permitted derivative for landing and email/social creative records.
expected_observable_result: Stable reference reused within allowed scope; no new uncontrolled product/artwork copy.

setup_and_steps: Publish page/campaign creative while outbound integration spies record effects.
expected_observable_result: No email/social/supplier/payment action; inquiries stay separate private request records.

setup_and_steps: Generate catalog/lookbook with published and paused/private product fixture records.
expected_observable_result: Only approved current public facts/media; no supplier/cost/private art; unsupported export unavailable.

setup_and_steps: Edit store A as assigned store admin, then request global/site B brand changes.
expected_observable_result: Only granted store fields editable; approved inheritance; no global/sibling changes.

setup_and_steps: Authorized editor selects canonical product and eligible variants for store assortment.
expected_observable_result: Store command validates grants/product eligibility; explicit status; customer sees only approved selection.

setup_and_steps: Change CMS notice copy; attempt purchase outside actual window or above real budget.
expected_observable_result: Presentation cannot bypass underlying store window/eligibility/budget commands.

setup_and_steps: Read private store page/metadata/asset as active member, deactivate, retry new requests.
expected_observable_result: Inactive member denied everywhere; existing read-policy mismatch corrected and regression protected.

setup_and_steps: Guess sibling store draft/release/logo/collection IDs as store admin or customer.
expected_observable_result: No sibling draft/private published content/metadata or asset access; public rules explicit.

setup_and_steps: Try approved palette/logo/layout versus arbitrary CSS/global brand override.
expected_observable_result: Allowed inherited values only; no arbitrary CSS or external code; access audited.

setup_and_steps: Curate a store collection including assigned and nonassigned products.
expected_observable_result: Only approved eligible assortment resolves; canonical products reused; no uncontrolled copies.

setup_and_steps: Exercise owner, marketing editor, explicitly granted manager/publisher, designer and customer roles.
expected_observable_result: Owner independent workflow works; editor cannot publish without capability; manager grant aligns kernel/handler.

setup_and_steps: Open preview then revoke session/resource grant; replay preview URL/credential.
expected_observable_result: Next protected request denied; short-lived token scoped/revocable if used; no global preview secret.

setup_and_steps: Post save/publish from untrusted origin and without required session/CSRF controls.
expected_observable_result: Denied; legitimate same-origin scoped operation works; no content side effect.

setup_and_steps: Submit javascript/data/file links, unapproved remote image URLs, huge docs and over-deep trees.
expected_observable_result: Bounded validation rejects dangerous input before resource-heavy processing; no SSRF/open redirect.

setup_and_steps: Edit CTA for unknown/unverified configuration and attempt to enable checkout via CMS payload.
expected_observable_result: CMS has no checkout toggle; current business validator offers quote-first and blocks unverified sale.

setup_and_steps: Configure a variant, save artwork, request quote, revise design and inspect accepted proof binding.
expected_observable_result: Correct variant/design/version hashes preserved; editorial changes cannot approve or release production.

scenario: Unknown bundle price and kit context
setup_and_steps: Build kit with unknown component price, quantities/specifications and shared artwork; hand off RFQ.
expected_observable_result: Missing total shows pending quote, never $0; agreement retains per-component config and kit identity.

setup_and_steps: Reorder historical configuration after catalog/options/rights have changed.
expected_observable_result: Fresh canonical compatibility/price checks; stale snapshot is not treated as currently purchasable.

setup_and_steps: Seed >1000 products/variants with uneven variant counts; page/search/facet to last eligible item.
expected_observable_result: No independent-cap truncation; stable pagination/facets; exact full eligible variants reachable.

setup_and_steps: Run representative content at fixed device/network profile, compare five warm runs and inspect HTML.
expected_observable_result: Published primary content discoverable; no private hydration; agreed budgets and regression gate recorded.

setup_and_steps: Test shop/editor at 320/390/768/1440 px, 200% zoom, reduced motion, open dialogs and menus.
expected_observable_result: No unintended overflow; named controls including account button; keyboard/focus and AA target pass.

setup_and_steps: Publish content/upload approved asset, restart runtime, restore isolated backup and compare graph.
expected_observable_result: Drafts/releases/active pointer/media survive; restored references/hashes consistent; no silent reseed.

setup_and_steps: Force idle shutdown/crash before and after commit, duplicate job delivery and resume executor.
expected_observable_result: Reliable wake demonstrated; exactly-once activation effect or visible blocked failure; audit complete.

setup_and_steps: Observe owner edit headline/image, reorder, curate collection, change menu, publish and rollback.
expected_observable_result: Unaided tasks within agreed target; no Git/SQL/deploy or developer action; actual saved/public revision verified.
